_week: 2026-10-26 to 2026-11-01 (Week 44). Written from that week's numbers; rewrite every key each Monday.
week_story: Revenue rose 5.8% to $19,781 on 1,000 orders (+4.8%), the second-best week since September after the Prime event week.
Metatarsal Pads (53% of sales) grew 5.7% to $10,556; the Small 6-pack jumped 39% to $1,879.
Metatarsal Bars grew 47% to $1,428, while Scaphoid Pads (-15%), Posting Heel Wedge (-19%) and Neuroma Pads (-28%) slipped.
refunds: Refunds fell to $943 (72 units, 7.2% of orders) from $1,051 the week before. Over the last 30 days the 2.5" x 7/16" Heel Lift (27%) and the 3" Medial/Lateral Heel Wedge (16%) had the highest refund rates among bigger sellers.
pacing_reco: November is only one day in ($2,319 on Nov 1), so the full-month pace is not meaningful yet; October closed at $88,044, the best month of the year.
ads_context: Ad spend rose 12.4% to $3,058 while ad sales grew only 3.9% to $7,255, so ACoS rose to 42.2% (from 39.0%) and TACoS to 15.5%.
Campaign and strategy tables cover the first 50 campaign rows from Sellerise (about 87% of spend); account totals are complete.
ads_strategy: Branded keywords returned $3,523 on $1,113 (31.6% ACoS) and brought 151 orders.
Category keywords cost $902 for $1,140 in sales (79.1% ACoS); Sponsored Display spent $102 for $16.
bid_moves: Lower bids on the category “metatarsal pads” phrase and broad targets: $339 spent for $508 in sales.
Pause the four campaigns that spent $85 with no sales, including the Dancer Pad (Men) auto campaign while that item is out of stock.
promotions: This week: 249 promotion orders and $533 in promotional discounts (vs 244 and $500 last week).
Discount levels are steady week to week.
events: Black Friday / Cyber Monday: Nov 27 – Nov 30.
Deal and coupon set-up deadlines: to confirm with the account team.
Priority: keep Scaphoid Pads and Metatarsal Pads well stocked at FBA into late November.
reviews_body: Sellerise returned no review records, rating trend or negative reviews for the 111 Hapad US products over the last 90 days.
That means the review tracker isn't pulling for this account, not that there were no reviews.
reviews_reco: Turn on review tracking for Hapad US in Sellerise (or pull Amazon's Customer Reviews report) so the deck can show star rating and review count per line.
Sellerise also shows 33 hijacker alerts and 47 lost-Buy-Box alerts in the last 30 days, including on the Medium 6-pack; worth checking alongside reviews.
recommendations: Cut bids on category “metatarsal pads” phrase/broad targets (79% category ACoS) and shift budget to branded phrase/exact, which ran at 32% ACoS.
Pause Sponsored Display contextual targets ($102 spend, $16 sales) and the Dancer Pad (Men) auto campaign while it is out of stock.
Add the converting search terms “hapad metatarsal pads women”, “metatarsal cookies” and “metatarsal bar for shoes” as exact keywords.
Restock Dancer Pads (Men) and Tongue Cushions (Women), both at 0 available, and send more of the 3/4 Length Insole (Women 6), about 2 weeks left.
Scaphoid Pads have 5.3 weeks available; confirm the 328 inbound units land before BF/CM.
Review the 33 hijacker and 47 lost-Buy-Box alerts, starting with the Metatarsal Pad Medium 6-pack (27% of sales).
Lock BF/CM coupons and deals for the Metatarsal Pad 6-packs and Metatarsal Bars.
position: October closed at $88,044, up from $76,680 in September, and this week added $19,781 (+5.8%).
Growth came from Metatarsal Pads and Bars; ad efficiency slipped as spend grew faster than ad sales.
next_steps: Trim category ad spend; lean on branded.
Restock the out-of-stock Dancer Pad and Tongue Cushion.
Check hijacker and Buy Box alerts.

Product costs (COGS) in Sellerise for profit reporting.
